name: Arvida Group Limited
summary: Arvida Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, owns, develops, and operates retirement villages and care facilities for the elderly in New Zealand. As of March 31, 2020, it operated approximately 32 retirement villages with 1,688 aged care beds and 2,475 retirement units. The company was formerly known as Hercules Limited. Arvida Group Limited was founded in 2014 and is based in Auckland, New Zealand.
